about: Every file this project takes from outside: the official archives its hash tables are built from and the compilers its installer tests use. Fetched and compared by tools/fetch.py; none of them is part of the project or of what is shipped (CLAUDE.md, open item 19).
licence_notes: Licence notes are short reminders written from memory on 2026-10-12, not legal texts: read the licence file of the package before passing anything on.

files.note: Address as Microsoft's download page states it (microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=8109, read 2026-10-17: 95.6 MB, version 9.29.1974.1). Microsoft publishes no SHA-256: the value is the first download's, with Microsoft's own signature on the package and on every library in it as the proof (checked by the builder).
